name: Vologda Russian
notes: Northern Russian, Vologda group. Полное оканье and soft цоканье — one affricate [tsʲ] for both ⟨ч⟩ and ⟨ц⟩ ('для значительной части вологодских говоров характерно употребление одной аффрикаты [ц']'), which is exactly the Northern-group system, so this spec adds no tables of its own and inherits `ru-x-northern` whole. Retained as a named code because the Vologda group is one of the two subtypes the Northern spec generalises over, and because the group's other diagnostics (strong consonantism, ⟨бм⟩/⟨дн⟩ assimilations, the -ой/-ей endings) are lexical and morphological rather than grapheme-level; encoding them would need sources not consulted for this spec.
